title: Safe Retry After an Ambiguous Tool Timeout: A Hand-Checkable Conformance Suite for Agent Recovery with Provider Contracts and Webhook Evidence (code, scenarios, results and paper)
description:
A deterministic, hand-checkable conformance suite, in standard-library Python, for the recovery layer around a side-effecting tool call that times out. A mock provider runs under two explicit contracts (no deduplication; deduplication on a stable key), with a lagging status endpoint and webhook receipts that can be delayed, duplicated, reordered, lost or misleading. A private effect ledger is used only for scoring.

Sixteen scripted scenarios (17 operations) and 120 timing schedules score immediate retry, check-then-retry, wait-then-verify, defer-and-report and evidence reconciliation, with sensitivity, ablation and persistent-fault analyses. Practitioner tools: run_sim.py explore for custom scenarios and policies, run_sim.py replay for recorded observations, a provider contract checklist and a decision table.

Run python3 run_sim.py to reproduce every result. Code: MIT. Paper, protocol, scenarios and results: CC BY 4.0. All data are synthetic.
